question: The Council of Ministers of a State is collectively responsible to its _______.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Legislative Assembly**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Council of ministers **of an Indian state is jointly responsible to the** legislative assembly.**
 
• Legislature of the association, which is known as** Parliament, **consists of the** President and two Houses, known as Council of States (Rajya Sabha) and House of the People (Lok Sabha).**
 
• Each House has to connect within** six months of its forgoing sitting.**
 
• A joint sitting of two Houses can be held in **determined cases.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• A **chief minister** leads a state government's council of ministers and can be debated in that role by a **deputy chief minister.**
 
• The** High Courts of India** are the highest courts of appellate jurisdiction in every **state and union territory of India. **
 
• **State executive** comprises of **Governor and Council of Ministers with Chief Minister as its head. ​ **
